summary: Routine signed package maintenance: mitmproxy and python-soupsieve updated; preexisting integration and configuration items remain pending.
changes: Full repository upgrade changed only mitmproxy 12.2.3-2 to 12.3.0-1 and python-soupsieve 3.0.3-1 to 3.0.4-1. Private preflight, plan, before/after evidence, selective rollback copies and local proposals recorded. Isolated update databases and package cache refreshed. Conventional post-transaction hooks armed the system update timestamp and checked rebuild requirements. Protected configuration, compatibility state, repository policy, drivers and existing jobs remained unchanged. No reboot or desktop migration.
tests: Local ChatGPT OAuth status passed before and after. Package database checks passed. Package integrity checks found zero altered files before and after. Prior and candidate archive signatures were trusted. Offline CSS selection including empty results, HTTP request object creation and proxy CLI imports passed before and after. Exact package delta verified; protected hashes unchanged; no new failed units. Fresh repository query found no pending upgrades. Final package-delta, paths and privacy review completed. GUI, game, proxy traffic and performance tests were not performed.
rollback: Retained copies of both prior package archives and detached signatures with verified hashes, plus configuration and sync metadata backup. Selective package rollback documented; not executed because checks passed. No global snapshot restore.
problem: Preexisting compatibility acceptance remains needs_attention. Current desktop packages and root-directory mode differ from the recorded installation profile; no demonstrated data exposure from the mode check alone.
solution: Applied only the reviewed routine package upgrades. Preserved genuine integration failure and recorded separate local proposals for integration evidence review, desktop reconciliation and permission-policy reconciliation. No job retry, acceptance promotion or security-policy change.
reproduction: Package inventory, integrity and database queries, isolated repository checks and offline runtime checks establish the maintenance result. Existing integration state records incomplete acceptance. No reproducible distribution-specific defect established.
